scope: synthetic smoke only; NOT a real-voyage runtime prediction
caveats: Inclusive nested stages are not summed twice. The estimate covers measured collection, Validation execution/report output and checkpoint serialization only; data loading, model construction, resume reconstruction, study bookkeeping and final output overhead are excluded. Adam updates come from result.json and must match timed training calls for the fixed gradient_steps=1 runner. Failures, voyage length, Replay size, network/batch size, report detail and machine load alter runtime. A small synthetic smoke cannot establish a full-dataset budget.
